name: Generation Love
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $200 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's blouses, sweaters, dresses, suiting, vegan-suede and faux-fur jackets, mostly $185–$700, sold through its own stores and site and Nordstrom.
origin: Founded in 2008 by Roni Hirshberg; Audrey Bressa.

quote.q: At Generation Love, we believe that confidence is the ultimate style statement.

opview: “At Generation Love, we believe that confidence is the ultimate style statement.” — Generation Love (house), About Us, generationloveclothing.com

facts_read.source: brand site (home, about, terms); nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue + item page; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Generation Love women's apparel; EXCLUDED: girls' (mini-me) pieces, jewellery, accessories, pet, pajamas, sale and final-sale

doors.note: Our Store page and footer list one store: Westhampton Beach, NY.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 363 styles (589 feed records less accessories, jewelry, gift card, pet, slippers, pajamas, wraps and 12 girls' styles = 542 listings,

craft_evidence.madein: <1% — 'Made in Thailand' on 4 of 589 feed records; 'Imported' on 11
craft_evidence.heritage: dated — launched 2008 by Roni Hirshberg and Audrey Bressa; 'Paris and New York' as inspiration, no place of making
craft_evidence.reasoning: A founding year and two founders' names are the only checkable facts. Product pages almost never state a country (4 of 589), and no maker, mill or process is named anywhere on the site.

notes.tech: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-14): no named technical fabric on the site. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
